`index.html` mein **Pocket Ops** naam ka playable, mobile-friendly aim trainer banaya hai. Isme touch joysticks, keyboard/mouse controls, Bluetooth gamepad detection, enemy waves, health, score aur dodge shamil hain. JavaScript syntax aur browser play test bhi pass kiya.

**Zaroori baat:** Yeh ek browser game/trainer hai—yeh khud tablet ko Bluetooth controller mein convert nahi karta, aur na hi Call of Duty Mobile se connect hota hai. Bluetooth controller ko tablet ki Settings se pair karein; COD Mobile mein controller support device aur game version par depend karta hai.
